title: Locally zero sections detect maps from a presheaf with zero sheafification on a finite basis
statement: Let (C,J) be a site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], A a Grothendieck abelian coefficient category [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian], and B a predicate on objects of C. Assume finite products in every Over V and that each covering sieve of a B-object contains a finite covering family all of whose nonempty repeated nerve terms satisfy B. Let P:C^op→A have zero sheafification. For V satisfying B and b:P(V)→T, suppose that for each such finite basis cover U of V, every coefficient object E and x:E→P(V), vanishing of all restrictions of x to the one-fold nerve terms of U implies x≫b=0. Then b=0. Different locally zero generalized sections may use different finite covers.

source.place: Section 7.10, the filtered-colimit local equality description before Lemma 7.10.8 and the finite-composition argument of Theorem 7.10.10 (Tag 00WB); categorical extension using AB5 and transfinite plus, not a claim of verbatim coefficient generality.

proof.text: Use exact filtered colimits to identify the kernel of P(V) to plus P(V) with the union of the kernels of matching-family restrictions. A finite refinement from hcov converts each such kernel into the kernel of the finite Cech augmentation; the hypothesis on b annihilates it. Implemented by kills_kernel_colimit, kills_kernel_toPlus and the opening argument of hom_eq_zero_of_sheafification_zero.

Prove that if the plus unit of K is zero, then plus K(V) is zero whenever covers of V have finite refinements. Choose finite generators of a covering subsieve, index further covers by the finite product of their filtered cover categories, and commute its colimit with the finite product by AB5. The induced map from the original matching object is zero. Each stage kernel becomes zero after composition of its covers with the finite family, hence dies in the plus colimit. Empty families are included. Implemented by matching_ι_of_factor and plus_isZero_of_toPlus_zero.

Apply the preceding result to the kernel of the plus unit of P. Its plus unit is zero by naturality and the fact that plus preserves monomorphisms. Left exactness then shows that the plus unit of plus P is monic at every B-object. Prove also that plus preserves morphisms monic at B-objects: their kernels vanish on B, and finite refinements show that plus of each such kernel vanishes on B. Replace a finite refinement by its singleton nerve family using diagonals; its members have B literally. Implemented by finite_basis_cover, isZero_matching_of_generators, plus_isZero_on_basis, mono_toPlus_plus_of_finite_basis and plus_map_mono_on_basis.

Iterate plus in the category of presheaves under Q = plus P. The property that Q to R is monic at B-objects is closed under isomorphisms and nonempty filtered colimits by AB5. At successors use naturality: the successor structure map equals the plus unit of Q followed by plus of the previous structure map, a composite of B-component monomorphisms. The transfinite induction principle gives a B-component monomorphism into the final iteration. Implemented by plusUnderSucc, monoOnBasisUnder, monoOnBasisUnder_iso, monoOnBasisUnder_colimits and mono_plusUnderIteration.

Choose a regular cardinal larger than the cardinality of Arrow C at which a separator of A is presentable. The final iteration under Q is a sheaf. Matching-family functors preserve these cardinal-filtered colimits, and matching-family inclusions into the next plus stage interleave the sheaf-condition maps with transitions. Apply IsColimit.isIso_of_interleave. This reuses the source library convergence proof without its SmallCategory C restriction. Implemented by isSheaf_plusUnderIteration.

The composite from P through Q into this sheaf factors through sheafification of P, hence is zero. The map from Q(V) into the sheaf value is monic, so the plus unit of P(V) is zero. Apply the first step to the identity of P(V) to conclude b = 0.

lean.statement:
theorem hom_eq_zero_of_sheafification_zero
    (B : C → Prop)
    (hcov : ∀ V, B V → ∀ R ∈ J V, ∃ (n : ℕ) (U : Fin n → Over V),
      (∀ (k : ℕ) (y : Fin (k + 1) → Fin n), B (Presheaf.cechNerveObj U y).left) ∧
      (∀ a, R (U a).hom) ∧
      Sieve.ofArrows (fun a ↦ (U a).left) (fun a ↦ (U a).hom) ∈ J V)
    (P : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ A) (hP : IsZero ((presheafToSheaf J A).obj P))
    (V : C) (hV : B V) {T : A} (b : P.obj (op V) ⟶ T)
    (h : ∀ {n : ℕ} (U : Fin n → Over V),
      (∀ (k : ℕ) (y : Fin (k + 1) → Fin n), B (Presheaf.cechNerveObj U y).left) →
      Sieve.ofArrows (fun a ↦ (U a).left) (fun a ↦ (U a).hom) ∈ J V →
      ∀ {E : A} (x : E ⟶ P.obj (op V)),
        x ≫ cechAugmentation U Over.mkIdTerminal ((Over.forget V).op ⋙ P) = 0 →
        x ≫ b = 0) : b = 0
